title: Female Warrior with Magic Hammer
description: A young woman with long dark hair in a topknot stands in a dynamic combat pose, smirking confidently. She holds a large purple warhammer in her left hand while her right hand emits a swirling purple and orange magical energy effect.
prompt: A confident young East Asian woman with long dark hair tied in a topknot with bone ornaments, wearing a cropped tribal top, dark pants with orange patterns, and purple boots. She stands in a wide combat stance holding a massive purple warhammer with intricate designs, her other hand glowing with swirling purple and orange magical flames. She has a cocky smirk, wearing leather straps and belts, detailed digital fantasy illustration on a solid dark gray background.
